summary: @or-sdk/deployer preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated 727KB payload at install time
details: On `npm install`, the package's `preinstall` script runs `node setup.mjs`, which checks for the `bun` runtime and, if absent, downloads a platform-specific Bun binary from oven-sh's GitHub releases, extracts it to a temporary directory, chmods it executable, and invokes the sibling file `math_init.js` under that freshly-fetched runtime via `execFileSync(bunPath, ['math_init.js'], {stdio:'inherit', cwd:D})`. `math_init.js` is a 727KB heavily obfuscated JavaScript bundle using string-array/index-rotation obfuscation (identifiers like `_0xNNNN`, a shuffle function operating on a ~1000-entry integer/string array). `setup.mjs` itself is also obfuscated with obfuscator.io-style renaming and per-call string-property dictionaries — atypical for a legitimate install/setup script. The obfuscated bundle is not referenced from the package's declared `main` and is only reached through this install-time execution path, so its contents are opaque to static inspection while it runs with the installer's user privileges. This is the alternate-runtime-dropper shape: an obfuscated payload delivered via a second runtime the package did not previously depend on, executed automatically on install.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
